{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values
num_unique_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()
num_total_rows = len(data)

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)

print(f'Unique patient_id count: {num_unique_patients}')
print(f'Total rows: {num_total_rows}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_patients.index.tolist()}')"}
